Class SparkRowTuple

java.lang.Object
smile.spark.SparkRowTuple
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Tuple
public class SparkRowTuple extends Object implements Tuple
An adapter wrapping an Apache Spark Row as a SMILE Tuple.
